nodes.label: MADYy.png — M.A.D.Y horizontal logo lockup (isotipo 2x2 rounded-square grid in sky-blue, navy-to-teal gradient circle, navy, and teal, paired with black 'M.A.D.Y.' wordmark and 'INOCUIDAD DIGITAL' tagline in uppercase tracked sans-serif). Horizontal lockup variant (icon + wordmark + tagline side by side) on transparent/white background, unlike icon-only or stacked variants. NOTE: tagline reads the deprecated 'Inocuidad Digital' slogan, not the current 'Inocuidad Inteligente' per CLAUDE.md brand rules.
